en: I came for the carvings and found these Pokémon floating between them. They look like the carvings come to life!
Every one of them is a different shape. I'm trying to see one of each, but I keep losing count.
When I was young the Ruins were only stones in a field. Now there's a whole hall under them. Who'd have thought?
We're copying out every carving on these pillars. There are more shapes than letters in any alphabet we know.
The Pokémon here are called Unown. They seem to gather wherever the carvings are thickest.
Each panel that was solved seems to have woken more of them. I wonder what solving all four would do.
Careful where you step. We've only just begun to map this place, and it may go deeper still.
Strange shapes are carved in rows down the pillar. They look a little like the Pokémon floating in the hall.
